name: TOTP Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user with TOTP enabled identifies the existing account, supplies a valid time-based one-time authenticator code, and establishes an authenticated application session without using the account password for that continuation path.
finalOutcome: The submitted TOTP proof is accepted for the existing durable identity and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Existing authentication view collects the TOTP verification code and permits password fallback.
